name: Bliss Valley
source:
You live in the quiet small town of Bliss Valley, enjoying a week-long vacation from work. While running errands on your first day, you’ll meet three unique and cute furry characters that you’ll be able to date, romance, and eventually seduce.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3524570/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你住在靜謐的幸福谷小鎮，正享受著為期一週的工作假期。放假第一天出門辦事，你將邂逅三位個性不同的可愛獸人。和他們約會、談情，最終引誘他們與你共赴雲雨。

［摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3524570/]Steam[/url]］
